dem: decompose_errors=True, other options default; iterate flattened error instructions in order
population: One row per distinct nonempty syndrome of one whole DEM source mechanism, uniformly counted. Report the empty input separately. Section 17 applies per cluster.
primary: Assign components the mask of their syntactic L0 occurrences. Verify detection and observable XOR against the unsplit source. Store every component and original p; collapse only identical endpoints plus mask in the Boolean existence search.
sensitivity: Within each source retain detector components and total observable XOR, assign total XOR to first component and zero to others. Same entire-source outcomes; deliberate change of local representatives for sensitivity only.
cluster: Connect active detectors at detector-only shortest hop distance <= 2, take connected components. Maximum cluster size 8, no adaptive enlargement.
DD_paths: All simple paths of at most 4 detector-detector edges between active members of the same cluster. Every visited detector is within 2 detector hops of at least one endpoint. No third active detector internally, no boundary transit. Equivalently two radius-2 searches may meet.
boundary_paths: One active detector to terminal boundary in at most 2 edges including the boundary edge, no other active detector internally. Unlimited boundary assignments. Every boundary edge keeps its mask.
explanations: Each active detector exactly once as an endpoint. Paths may overlap; bits of chosen paths XOR. Existence only, no weights, pruning, ties, margins, inference PASS or sampling.
shot: XOR product of cluster classes reported for diagnostics. A nonempty shot advances past section 17 only if every cluster has both classes. Any missing explanation blocks it. Empty shot has one empty explanation of parity 0 and no clusters; no decoder status assigned.
boundary_stratum: boundary_adjacent if at least one active detector has a direct boundary edge; otherwise interior. This is graph adjacency, not a spacetime coordinate classification.
controls: main single-edge fixture and empty input
boundary cannot connect clusters in transit
shared observable masks cancel by XOR
independent pattern verifier on every nonempty source syndrome
